metaDescription: Continuous external-surface change intelligence and evidence-backed security monitoring.
paywallBody: Guardian turns verified observations into change intelligence, Exposure Drift, living controls, traceable recommendations and board-ready reporting when monitoring and the scheduler are configured.
paywallStat1Detail: Meaningful external changes are correlated after scheduled scans.
paywallStat2Detail: Evidence-backed posture that evolves with every scan.
paywallStat3Detail: Every conclusion remains traceable to an observation.
driftSecondObservation: A second observation will establish the drift line.
notEnoughEvidence: Not enough deterministic evidence yet — Guardian will not guess.
baselineReadyTitle: Guardian is ready to establish a baseline
baselineReadyBody: Run a verified scan or let your next scheduled monitor complete. Guardian will build its first factual inventory, then begin correlating meaningful changes over time.
noCertificateEvidence: No certificate lifetime evidence in the latest observation.
noMeaningfulChanges: No meaningful changes since the baseline. Guardian is still watching.
noOpenReviewItems: No open review items. Guardian will create one only when observations support it.
activityEmpty: Guardian activity will appear after the first analyzed scan.
connectedWorkflowsBody: Important changes are grouped by context. Three related medium events trigger one notification; high-severity changes are delivered immediately.
secretsProtected: Secrets encrypted at rest · HTTPS + IP pinning
emailEnabled: Email is enabled through workspace notification preferences.
connectWorkflowHint: Connect an operational workflow for grouped Guardian intelligence.
controlExplanation: Guardian evaluates {control} from deterministic public observations.
controlWhy: The {control} control affects the reliability and protection of the public surface.
actionSpf: Publish one provider-aligned SPF policy and keep it within the DNS lookup limit.
actionDkim: Enable DKIM signing and verify an aligned signature on outbound mail.
actionDmarc: Start DMARC reporting, correct alignment, then progress to enforcement.
actionDnssec: Enable DNSSEC and publish the matching DS record through the registrar.
actionHsts: Add HSTS after confirming all covered hosts support HTTPS.
actionHttps: Provision a trusted certificate, redirect HTTP to HTTPS and remove mixed content.
actionSecurityTxt: Publish /.well-known/security.txt with Contact and Expires fields.
actionMtaSts: Publish and validate MTA-STS before moving the policy to enforcement.
actionTls: Use managed certificate renewal and alert before expiry.
actionEmailSecurity: Resolve the individual mail controls and verify them again on the next scan.
eventWhySurface: External-surface changes should be reconciled with an owner and an expected business purpose.
eventWhyIdentity: Identity and domain changes can affect access, ownership and business continuity.
eventWhyMail: Mail-routing and authentication changes affect brand protection, delivery and continuity.
eventWhyInfrastructure: Infrastructure changes can reflect a deployment, migration, failover or unexpected modification.
eventWhyCertificate: Certificate lifecycle changes can cause outages and should be reconciled with planned work.
eventWhyPosture: A deterministic security-control observation changed between consecutive scans.
driftBaselineNarrative: This scan establishes the first factual baseline. Drift becomes available after another observation.
driftStableNarrative: No material movement was observed across Guardian's tracked dimensions.
recommendationOwnershipTitle: Confirm ownership of possible shadow infrastructure
recommendationOwnershipReview: Map the asset to a business owner, purpose, data classification and retirement plan.
recommendationNonprodReview: Confirm that public exposure is intentional, then review access, data, logging and ownership controls.
recommendationAuthReview: Confirm ownership, intended audience, identity provider, MFA policy and decommissioning path.
recommendationApiReview: Confirm the owner, consumers, authentication requirement, data classification and production status.
recommendationFlappingReview: Reconcile DNS, deployment, uptime and retirement records with the observed presence sequence.
recommendationGrowthReview: Review newly observed assets as a group and assign an owner, environment, purpose and lifecycle state.
recommendationGenericReview: Review the evidence, confirm ownership and document the intended public state.
recommendationOwnershipImpact: Unowned infrastructure increases incident-response time and creates lifecycle gaps.
recommendationNonprodImpact: Non-production systems can expose internal workflows or weaker operational controls.
recommendationAuthImpact: Unexpected authentication entry points expand the organization's identity boundary.
recommendationApiImpact: New APIs can expand integration and data exposure even when correctly implemented.
recommendationFlappingImpact: Unstable or intermittently exposed services are harder to own and monitor reliably.
recommendationGrowthImpact: Rapid inventory growth increases operational complexity and the probability of unmanaged assets.
recommendationGenericImpact: Unreviewed external changes can create ownership, lifecycle and monitoring gaps.
recommendationWhy: Deterministic public observations support this review item; it is not a claim of compromise.
recommendationReasoning: Guardian correlated evidence across {count} affected assets.
guideRecordOwner: Record the confirmed owner and expected public exposure.
guideRunAgain: Run Guardian again after the review or remediation.
guideVerification: Confirm that the next Guardian observation matches the documented intended state.
activityNotificationQueued: A Guardian notification was queued for {target}.
activityDigestGenerated: A Guardian digest was generated for {target}.
activityRecommendationUpdated: A Guardian recommendation was updated for {target}.
traceableRelationships: {count} traceable relationships · providers → observations → resolved entities → finding
noMatchingObservations: No deterministic observations match this finding.
evidenceSnapshotUnavailable: No immutable evidence snapshot is available for this finding yet.
evidenceLoadFailed: Evidence Intelligence could not be loaded.
whyWeBelieveBody: This conclusion is supported by {count} immutable deterministic observations.
confidenceBody: Confidence reflects evidence quality, provider agreement and entity resolution; it does not claim exploitation.
contradictionBody: Providers reported conflicting values for {subject}; human review is required.
evidenceGapBody: An additional independent observation is needed before confidence can increase.
historyNeedsObservations: More observations are needed for historical comparison.
providerEvidenceBody: Provider contributed {count} immutable observations to this snapshot.
entityResolutionBody: The entity was resolved from public evidence with {confidence}% confidence.
eventEmailIntro: OUTSIDE Guardian grouped {count} important changes for {target}.
digestHeadlineChanged: External exposure changed, with no material deterioration.
digestExecutiveSummary: Guardian observed {new} new assets, {returning} returning assets, {removed} disappearances and {signals} new surface signals. {recommendations} recommendations remain open.
digestChangeLine: Change status: {new} new, {returning} returning, {removed} disappeared, {signals} new surface signals and {alerts} high-priority alerts.
